_comment: 2018 dijet MC rho_skim, brought in line with the 2016APV/2016/2017 counterparts on 2026-08-08. This file was previously a stale LPC config (executor_mode dask-lpc, redirector lpc, casa false) that could not run on coffea-casa at all, and it carried mode `rho_skim` while the 2018 dijet DATA config, every other era's dijet MC config, and the actually-produced 2018 outputs (named rho_skim10_dijet_mg_pythia8_2018_*) all use `rho_skim10`. Mode `rho_skim10` matches the data prescale for this channel so MC and data compare bin-for-bin -- that invariant is stated in the sibling configs' comments. Run via `python scripts/run_dijet_skim_split.py --config <this>` -- one submit per HT bin for the 4-core/8-GiB casa client-reduce reason. Era plumbing for 2018: JEC Summer19UL18_V5_MC / Summer19UL18_Run{ABCD}_V5_DATA, JER Summer19UL18_JRV2_MC, lumi 59.8 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_314472-325175_13TeV_Legacy2018_Collisions18_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2018.json.
